gloss: brush cutter; grass trimmer; weed cutter

definitions.gloss: brush cutter; grass trimmer; weed cutter
definitions.explanation: A machine for cutting down grass and weeds, typically the shoulder-carried type with a long shaft and a spinning blade or nylon cord at the end. Used on farmland, roadsides, and around houses.

examples.english: To cut the grass with a brush cutter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{草刈|くさか}り{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かしている→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: My father has been running the brush cutter since morning.

examples.japanese: {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧メガネ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: When you use a brush cutter you need safety goggles, because stones fly up.
